subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving registered, returning fans for {Brand}. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the registered, engaged user and read it back through a de-duplicated server-to-server registration postback into your MMP, so an install counts only once it becomes a verified follower who comes back for the next match. That is how we drove engaged registrations for Sofascore and FotMob at scale. If it helps, I can share the registration-to-return view. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate registration-quality proof (Sofascore + FotMob)
illustrative_flags: engaged registrations at scale for Sofascore and FotMob (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN sports_media_and_community: references prior outreach in S1; restates single proof from parent (registration optimization + S2S de-duplicated postback + Sofascore/FotMob); one illustrative MobUpps proof flagged, never stated as fact; reuses only parent brands; soft CTA, 1 question mark; native en; no sign-off; no em-dash; X-not-Y avoided.
